question: What is the minimum over rate per hour in a test match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15 overs per hour**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The minimum over rate in a test match is **15 overs per hour**.
 
• Over rates are a crucial aspect of maintaining the game's pace and ensuring that spectators get to watch a fair amount of play.
 
• Teams must adhere to this rate to avoid penalties, including fines or point deductions in the World Test Championship.
 
• Effective over-rate management involves strategic planning and efficient field placements to minimize time wastage between deliveries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) monitors over rates in international matches and can impose sanctions on teams falling short.
 
• In recent years, various measures such as time limits for innings and penalties for slow over rates have been introduced to speed up the game.
 
• Maintaining a good over rate not only keeps the game engaging but also demonstrates the professionalism and discipline of the team.
 
• Technological advancements, such as the use of digital timers and improved communication systems, have also helped in managing over rates more effectively.
